title: Behind the Veil
subtitle: hideUntilDependenciesVisible
description: `hideUntilDependenciesVisible` means: not drawn until at least one of its
prerequisites is itself visible. First Light is visible from the start, so this
quest appears the moment the book is opened -- but The Second Veil behind it
does not, because this one was not visible a moment ago.
The flag is recursive, which is the whole trick: a chain of hidden quests lights
up from its first visible end, one link at a time, as you walk it.
